integrity: An infinite-family direct proof is given; computations are independent finite corroboration, not proof. Bibliographic precedence not independently established.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple cubic Möbius ladders M_{2n}, n>=3 only; six-solution census only in the extremal n congruent 3 modulo 6 phase; possible unindexed equivalent graph-theoretic statement. General edge-count bound and equality characterization predate this result.
title: Sharp six-periodic edge open packing and six-solution rigidity of Möbius ladders
